extracted.intended_audience: CIA Personnel Division and Legislative Liaison Division staff handling congressional personnel referrals
extracted.subtask_description: Administrative procedure for how congressional references (Form 57/applicants sent via congressional offices) are to be handled, screened, and processed between the Legislative Liaison Division and the Personnel Division, including timelines and notification requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assigned responsibility for processing congressional references
rubrics_metrics.description: The Chief, Personnel Division, and the Chief, Legislative Liaison Division, P & A, are hereby instructed to carry out the following procedure in connection with congressional references of personnel to CIG for consideration for employment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Directive that these two chiefs share responsibility for implementing the entire procedure described on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Immediate referral of congressional communications to Legislative Liaison Division
rubrics_metrics.description: All congressional calls and communications in connection with personnel matters will, immediately upon receipt, be referred to the Legislative Liaison Division of the Personnel and Administrative Branch.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any personnel-related contact from a congressional office must not be handled elsewhere first; it must be routed straight to the Legislative Liaison Division for action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request submission of Form 57 or bring applicant for interview
rubrics_metrics.description: Request the congressional office concerned to either submit forms 57 for consideration or send applicant to that division for interview. Applicant should bring Form 57 with him.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Legislative Liaison Division should ask Congress to supply the standardized Form 57 or have the candidate appear in person with the form to allow screening.

rubrics_metrics.name: Arrange personnel interview when applicant appears qualified
rubrics_metrics.description: If examination of the Form 57 or result of interview indicates that applicant may possess qualifications currently needed by CIG, the Chief of the Legislative Liaison Division will arrange for an interview with the Chief of the Personnel Procurement Section or his deputy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Screening by Legislative Liaison triggers escalation to Personnel Procurement leadership for a formal interview when qualifications match current needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Process and notify when applicant lacks immediate-interest qualifications
rubrics_metrics.description: If examination of Form 57 or result of interview indicates no special qualifications of immediate interest to CIG, the applicant will be informed that his Form 57 will be reviewed and decision as to employment furnished him within two weeks. In such case no further interview will be arranged, but Form 57 will be forwarded to the Chief of the Personnel Division for further action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When candidate is not an immediate fit, do not schedule further interviews; instead ensure review and a decision communicated within a two-week timeline and forward paperwork to Personnel Division.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inform congressional office of actions and final decision
rubrics_metrics.description: Will inform the congressional office concerned of the above preliminary action and of the final decision when such decision has been made.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Legislative Liaison Division must keep the referring congressional office apprised both of initial handling steps and the final outcome.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordinate other personnel matters and report to congressional offices
rubrics_metrics.description: Coordinate action on other types of personnel matters to insure expeditious completion and inform the congressional office concerned of action taken.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beyond referrals of applicants, the Legislative Liaison Division must coordinate different personnel case types to ensure prompt resolution and notify the congressional office of what was done.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure personal interview by Personnel Procurement chief or deputy
rubrics_metrics.description: Issue necessary instructions to the Chief of his Procurement Section to insure personal interview by himself or his deputy where interviews are arranged.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Personnel Division leadership must require that arranged interviews be conducted personally by the Procurement Section chief or that chief's deputy, not delegated lower, ensuring consistent interview authority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Process Form 57 and furnish basis for final reply within 14 days
rubrics_metrics.description: Insure that forms 57 in these cases, regardless of whether an interview has been necessary, are processed expeditiously and basis for final reply furnished the Legislative Liaison Division within 14 days in each case.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Personnel Division must complete processing and provide the Legislative Liaison Division with the rationale/basis for the final reply within a strict 14-day timeframe for every case.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inform applicant within 14 days if no suitable position exists
rubrics_metrics.description: Insure that applicant is informed within 14 days if no suitable position exists currently for his employment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must receive notification within 14 days when there is no current suitable position; this is a standing timeline requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide prompt assistance to Legislative Liaison for congressional replies
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide expeditious assistance to the Legislative Liaison Division in other types of personnel cases to enable prompt and intelligent replies to be made to congressional offices in each case.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Personnel Division must support Legislative Liaison with timely information and help so that responses to congressional inquiries are prompt and well-informed.
